style: position: relative; display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 0 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; text-align: left; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; transition:all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); &:hover { border-color: #38bdf8; } &:focus-within, &.has-value { border-color: #38bdf8; } &:focus-within > .legend-data, &.has-value > .legend-data { visibility: visible; max-width: 100%; } &:focus-within > .label-data, &.has-value > .label-data { top: 0; left: 5px; padding: 0 10px; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 11px; transform: translateY(-50%); } &:has(svg) { .label-data { padding-left: 25px; } .svg-wrapper { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; transform: translateY(-50%); } &:focus-within > .label-data, &.has-value > .label-data { padding-right: 40px; padding-left: 30px; .svg-wrapper { left: 10px; width: 15px; height: 15px; } } } &.has-value { .input-data { color: var(--color-black, #000); -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-black, #000); &[type='date']::-webkit-datetime-edit { color: var(--color-black, #000); -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-black, #000); } } }

text: /* @component: .js-container-input-data */ (function () { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { document.querySelectorAll('.js-container-input-data').forEach(function (fs) { const input = fs.querySelector('input'); const label = fs.querySelector('label'); const legendSpan = fs.querySelector('legend span'); if (label && legendSpan) { legendSpan.innerHTML = label.innerHTML; } if (input) { function updateValueClass() { if (input.value) { fs.classList.add('has-value'); } else { fs.classList.remove('has-value'); } } updateValueClass(); input.addEventListener('input', updateValueClass); input.addEventListener('change', updateValueClass); input.addEventListener('blur', updateValueClass); fs.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target !== input) { input.focus(); } if (typeof input.showPicker === 'function') { try { input.showPicker(); } catch (err) { } } }); } }); }); })();
